name: Tideborne Mooncurrent Coral
description: A silver-blue coral that drinks moonlit surf.
specialEffects: Used in sea bows, moonwashed gear, and tidal stringwork.

steps: Refine raw stock for Tideborne Mooncurrent Coral under controlled heat and pressure.
